notes.title: MASSIVE VERSION 3.0 UPDATE!
notes.content:
VERSION 3.0 is a MASSIVE OVERHAUL of the game, increasing difficulty while adding more depth to the weapon system and story. 

UPDATE 16/09/2024

- New weapon set! You now have 4 unique weapons at your disposal at all times

- Use your bombs to cancel bullets for MASSIVE SCORES! Gotta grab those diamonds. 

- Enjoy brand new enemy types with more challenging patterns! 

- More levels, more bullets... more everything!

notes.title: Update!!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Following some initial player feedback I have made some improvements to the game;

[list]
[*] changed player hit box to central heart on the player character rather than below
[*] added vocal FX to star shield, 1up and medal multiplier
[*] adjusted plasma weapon FX
[*] adjusted lock on moon ball weapon, should be clearer when the charge is ready
[/list]

Please enjoy the game!
